purpose: Collect exact paired evidence for one repository-owned structural Build Impact candidate without sharing Gradle or source state between arms.

inputs.buildoptExecutableSha256: SHA-256 computed from the exact installed executable
inputs.gradleOptions: one identical allowlisted option vector for both arms

isolation.nativeBuildCache: one independently warmed and restored seed per arm
isolation.network: unchanged by the command; callers may require offline mode

measurement.control: optimized native Gradle over original entrypoints
measurement.candidate: installed BuildOpt Build Impact over the analyzed alternative

gates.requiredOutputEquality: byte- and path-identical in every arm and pair

decisions.qualified: write QUALIFIED evidence for review by buildopt profile evaluate
decisions.nonPositive: write INCONCLUSIVE evidence and retain optimized native Gradle
decisions.invalidOrUnsafe: write no evidence and fail closed
